title: Yod: Hand, Work (ancient pictograph to Y, I)
summary: Teaches the Hebrew letter yod (sounds Y, I; value 10; meaning Hand, Work) in three different letter shapes above a long line, then shows the ancient hand pictograph changing into a later upright form and then into the modern Y, I.

letters.meaning: hand, work (arm and hand pictograph); sounds Y, I

numbers.note: gematria value of the letter yod

pictures.description: Small ancient (paleo-Hebrew) yod pictograph: a hand and forearm drawn as a black stroke with a hooked end, over an orange underline, placed between 10 and Hand, Work.

Three-step letter evolution: the large ancient hand pictograph of yod over an orange underline, an arrow to a later upright forked form that looks like a Y, and an arrow to the large red-brown letters Y, I.

uncertain: The three yod shapes at the top are different typefaces/styles; the slide gives no caption for them.
